channel.title: logdetective jobs on Packit Service Status

item.title: [Resolved] Logdetective integration disrupted
item.description: The Logdetective integration is disrupted. We are working on integrating packit-service with the new Logdetective async service version. Update: The integration of the new Logdetective API has been finished and Logdetective analysis jobs are functional again.
item.content:
The Logdetective integration is disrupted.

We are working on integrating packit-service with the new Logdetective async service version.

Update: The integration of the new Logdetective API has been finished and Logdetective analysis jobs are functional again.
